page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4.2xlarge is a virtualized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 31.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. Notably, it includes a fractional GPU allocation consisting of 0.1667 of an NVIDIA A10 GPU with 4 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple categories. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1631.0 and a multi-core score of 8775.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 16850.01. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block bandwidth of 843.39 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 44.65 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the fractional GPU configuration delivers 813.5 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model, though performance drops to a weak tier of 17.34 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

The fractional GPU model offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage by allowing users to access GPU-accelerated hardware without the expense of provisioning a full dedicated GPU. This resource density is beneficial for entry-level graphics rendering or lightweight machine learning inference. However, the lack of local storage requires users to attach external block storage, and the 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth may limit high-throughput data transfers.

This instance is suited for workloads requiring modest GPU acceleration and dedicated CPU resources. Appropriate use cases include lightweight LLM inference on small models, basic ray tracing, image processing, software compilation, and database operations.
